POWER_OPTIONS_HIBERNATE_DESCRIPTION: Powers off your computer, but restores the session when powered back on
POWER_OPTIONS_LOCK_DESCRIPTION: Locks your computer with your password
POWER_OPTIONS_LOG_OUT_DESCRIPTION: Ends your session but keeps your computer on for others
POWER_OPTIONS_PROMPT: What do you want to do now?
POWER_OPTIONS_REBOOT_DESCRIPTION: Turns off your computer and turns it back on again
POWER_OPTIONS_SUSPEND_DESCRIPTION: Puts your computer in a low power state so it reopens quickly
